title: Goldreich–Levin stage step program
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive accuracy numerator and denominator $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Given $k<n$, a current query state, and a finite active family of coordinate subsets, the step program first charges the prescribed controller computation cost, then runs the stage query program and maps its output records to the state obtained by applying the Goldreich–Levin query step to the current state.
hypotheses_covered: finite active family of coordinate subsets
